## About
Long's Car Care Center is a local, family-owned shop in Woodinville, led by Randy Long. We treat every vehicle with the same care and attention we'd give our own.
We keep detailed records of your vehicle's service history and send maintenance reminders, so you can stay ahead of problems instead of reacting to them. When something does go wrong, we tell you what we found, what your options are and what it will cost.
Our neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating across 420 Google reviews, and a lot of them keep coming back and sending friends and family our way.

## Services
- Oil changes: Routine oil changes to keep your engine running well.
- Preventative maintenance: Scheduled maintenance and regular service reminders to help you avoid unexpected breakdowns.
- Electrical diagnosis and repair: Tracking down charging system and other electrical problems.
- Brakes and ABS: Brake service and repair, including ABS diagnostics.
- Suspension, steering and exhaust: Repairs to keep your car handling right and running clean.
- Emissions repairs: Repairs to address emissions problems.
- Cooling and air conditioning: Service for your cooling and air conditioning systems.
- Tire puncture repair: A reviewer who came in with a tire going flat got immediate attention and a repair.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to noon and 1:00 to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What if I can't get there during business hours?
A: Use our secure key drop box just outside the front door, and we'll get started on your car first thing in the morning.

Q: What kind of parts do you use?
A: We use high-quality OEM or equivalent parts and products.
